lines: #When you can't pay on time, you pay late *fees.*
When you can't afford quality, you buy cheap and buy *twice.*
When you have no savings, a small emergency becomes a *big* debt.
So you pay more for the same things than people who *have* money.
The less you have, the more everything *costs.*
#That's why the first step isn't getting *rich.*
#A small cushion means no more late *fees.*
Paying on time means no more *penalties.*
Buying once, buying right, means no more *replacing.*
Not because you earn more. Because you stopped *leaking.*
That's when money stops being an *emergency.*
end: Save this. Getting ahead starts small.
